client.onboarding.welcome_body: Here you see your greeting, credits and quick access to your profile. Your whole home, in one place.
client.onboarding.passport_body: Your property’s technical history. Each service adds to your home health score and maintenance records.
client.onboarding.promos_body: Active discounts, gift visits for family and other promotions available to you.
client.onboarding.points_body: You earn points on every service and $5,000 for each friend you invite. Redeem them at checkout.
client.onboarding.services_body: Choose plumbing, electrical, locksmith or another. Enter the address, pay the visit and track the technician live.
client.onboarding.nav_body: Home: passport · Invite: referrals · History: past services · Profile: your details.
client.onboarding.concierge_body: Throughout the service Sofia updates you on every milestone (search, assignment, arrival, quote). Open it with the Sofia button when you need help.
client.js.open_request_body: You have a pending request in Fandez.
client.guide.step1_body: On the home screen choose the service you need (plumber, electrician, locksmith, etc.). Enter the address, confirm on the map and describe the problem.
client.guide.step1_tip: You can enable "Gift service" if someone else will receive the visit at their home.
client.guide.step2_body: Review the total, apply your Fandez credit, redeem points or enter a promo code if you have one. Then confirm payment.
client.guide.step2_tip: If the total is $0, the service is confirmed automatically.
client.guide.step3_body: After paying you'll see real-time status: finding technician, assignment, on the way and arrival. You can call the provider from the app.
client.guide.step3_tip: Share the Guardian Mode link with your family so they can follow the service without creating an account.
client.guide.step4_body: Each completed service adds to your property's technical history and improves your home health score.
client.guide.step4_tip: Check the Home tab in the bottom bar.
client.guide.step5_body: Update your address in Profile to speed up future requests. In Invite you earn $5,000 per friend and in History you see all your services.
client.guide.extra_support_body: Use the purple Sofia button. The agent helps first; service issues go to a partner, and payment issues notify admin by email/platform (no WhatsApp).
client.guide.extra_gift_body: When paying for a gift you can notify the beneficiary via WhatsApp with a ready message and tracking link.
